title: The Monthly Payment Trap Costs You $8,700
hook: The second a car dealer asks 'what monthly payment works for you?' — the trap is already set, and it costs you $8,700.
angle: Car dealers deliberately frame every negotiation around monthly payment to hide the total cost, stretching loans to 84 months while buyers celebrate 'affordable' payments they can't escape
audience: Anyone who has bought or is about to buy a car — and anyone who has ever said 'I just need it under $400 a month'
key_numbers: $8,700 extra paid on average by monthly-payment-focused buyers
84-month loans cost $3,200 more in interest than 60-month loans
1 in 3 new car buyers is underwater (owes more than the car is worth) by month 18
